CardDescription.DefaultText: A pine-covered hillside pockmarked with sett-diggings and burrow entrances.

CardHelpSection.DefaultText: Pine Clearing: Conditions: Acidic soil. Flora: Pines, Birch, Appleweed, Healer's Moss, Fireroot, Pine Nuts (autumn), Fly Agaric, Meadowgrass. Fauna: Sett-diggings and burrows pockmark the hillside; the badger colony the warren is named for keeps mostly out of sight by day.
